metadata.title: Cinematic Hip-Hop Portrait with Cosmic Overlay

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, extreme close-up portrait of a male face merged with a cosmic space background and heavy metallic block lettering.
triggerTerms: extreme close-up portrait with space background
low-key lighting face with cosmic overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic composition featuring a tight crop of a man's face on the left, transitioning through a diagonal lens flare into a view of Earth from space on the right, anchored by heavy, layered sans-serif typography in the lower right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme close-up face balanced by wide-angle cosmic horizon
Cool blue shadows contrasted with warm gold typographic accents
Diagonal light streak separating the human subject from the celestial background
Heavy metallic textures in text mirroring the sharp skin detail
coreInvariants: Extreme close-up cropping of the eyes and nose
Diagonal composition split between subject and background
High-contrast low-key lighting with deep blue tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies the entire left two-thirds of the frame in an extreme close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the subject serve as the primary focal point, with the large metallic text acting as the secondary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's gaze, follows the diagonal light streak down to the right, and rests on the bold typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with texture, though the dark areas of the face provide visual rest.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and midnight blue (shadows and space)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool cyan and white (highlights and lens flares)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with desaturated skin tones and highly saturated blue cosmic elements.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy block weights with minimal counters
Beveled edges and metallic texture overlays
Stencil-like horizontal cuts in specific characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal gaps in the middle of vertical strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking a silver metallic primary title over a gold-toned secondary title for material contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight for the blocky look.
Matches the squared-off geometric feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an extreme close-up portrait of a man's face in low-key blue lighting on the left, merging via a diagonal cyan light streak into a view of Earth from space with a starfield on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of heavy, metallic, beveled block text in the lower right. The top line should be silver and the bottom line gold with horizontal stencil gaps.

verificationChecks: Is the face cropped tightly to show only eyes, nose, and mouth?
Does the diagonal light streak clearly separate the face from the space background?
Is the typography rendered with a 3D metallic bevel effect?
Is the color palette strictly limited to blues, blacks, and metallic accents?

adjustableVariables: Curvature of the Earth in the background
Amount of metallic weathering on the text
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original subject
Specific brand names in the metadata text

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on skin texture and eyes
Seamless blending of the cosmic background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite metallic textures
Confirm the presence of the cosmic horizon
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme Close-up Portrait + Diagonal Cosmic Transition + Heavy Metallic Block Typography
